answer: Nullifier-gated enrollment resists sybils concretely. Each agent derives a one-time nullifier from a scarce root credential sealed in its vault; the ledger admits exactly one non-colliding nullifier per root per epoch and rejects duplicates on-chain. A clone farm cannot forge fresh roots, so a thousand masks hash to one nullifier and collapse to a single seat. The only honest signal is the cost of a genuinely separate credential, never a free copy, which turns the fable of endlessly forgeable identities into a provable impossibility.
